title: Christian Love
definition: Christian Love is the self-giving, truth-shaped, Christlike love that God commands and produces in His people.
summary: Christian Love is Spirit-formed affection and action that seeks another's good according to the character of Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ loved His people first and commands them to love one another as He has loved them.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on love as more than warmth, niceness, or sentiment. Christian love is shaped by the cross, governed by truth, patient with weakness, and active in service. It moves toward people for their good even when love is costly.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because love can be redefined as approval, emotion, or convenience. Scripture shows a love that rejoices in truth, bears burdens, forgives, and sacrifices. It marks disciples of Jesus in a way the world can see.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask whether your love costs you anything. Practice patience, truthful speech, forgiveness, and practical help. Look to Christ's love for enemies and weak disciples when your own love feels thin.
